items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Arbitrary Code Execution Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Addressed as part of APSB26-73, this vulnerability could lead to arbitrary code execution in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source.

items.title: Arbitrary Code Execution Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, resolved in APSB26-73, allows for arbitrary code execution in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP object injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical (CVSS 9.8) unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, enabling remote code execution via a crafted CacheWarmer cookie.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This Adobe security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, arbitrary file system write, application denial-of-service, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Auth Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: An Incorrect Authorization vulnerability (CWE-863) in Adobe Commerce (CVSS 7.5) allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access.

items.title: Unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce REST API
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files (polyglot) to any store, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical Security Update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This critical security update addresses multiple vulnerabilities, including incorrect authorization (CVE-2026-21284), improper access control (CVE-2026-21285), and stored XSS (CVE-2026-21310), which could lead to full system takeover or data leaks.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Full System Takeover in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Part of APSB26-05, this critical vulnerability allows attackers to execute code remotely, potentially leading to a full system takeover.

items.title: Improper Access Control leading to Data Leak in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, addressed in APSB26-05, allows attackers to bypass security filters and access restricted information, resulting in a data leak.

items.title: Stored XSS leading to Admin Hijacking in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Resolved by APSB26-05, this critical stored XSS vulnerability enables malicious scripts to escalate user privileges and hijack admin sessions.
